name: Arcane Mage
summary: Reworked into a proc-driven burst spec built around Arcane Blast stacks. Strong single-target damage, but mana-hungry and fragile, with no Ice Block.
rotation: Open with Arcane Blast to build stacks
Spend Arcane Concentration procs on Arcane Blast
Arcane Missiles on Missile Barrage procs (from about 2 stacks)
Arcane Wrath at 3-4 stacks depending on mana
Fire Blast on cooldown to trigger Heating Up
Pyroblast at 3 Heating Up stacks with 3-4 Arcane Blast stacks
At 4 stacks: Arcane Power + Presence of Mind on big spells, then restart
talents: Missile Barrage, Arcane Concentration, Arcane Meditation, Arcane Wrath, Arcane Mind and Arcane Power, dipping into Fire for Pyroblast and Heating Up.
bestRaces: Orc: Blood Fury spell power (top PvE pick)
Skyborne: haste + Read Ley Line mana
forevChanges: Rebuilt into a competitive proc-based spec via Arcane Blast, Missile Barrage and Arcane Wrath.
tips: Watch mana closely after the third Arcane Blast stack
Save Evocation for long fights (pair with Read Ley Line on Skyborne)
Conjure a Mana Agate before every long fight
Kite with Frost Nova and line of sight

name: Fire Mage
summary: Crit-fuelled burst through Heating Up, Ignite and Fire Power, strong in dungeons and raids once geared. Weak while levelling, when low crit makes its mechanics unreliable.
rotation: Combustion for burst; Fire Blast on cooldown
Fireball, refreshing Scorch before it drops
talents: Ignite, Pyroblast, Heating Up, Critical Mass, Fire Power and Combustion; a Frostfire variant takes Shatter and Fingers of Frost.
forevChanges: New Heating Up makes Pyroblast usable in combat; Fire Power is now a stacking buff; Ignite was nerfed so Ignite-rolling is gone.
tips: Stack crit from gear and talents
Take Elemental Precision for dungeons and bosses
Burning Soul reduces spell pushback
Rely on Blink, kiting and crowd control: no Ice Block

name: Frost Mage
summary: Controls fights with slows and freezes, has the best survivability of the three Mage specs, and bursts frozen targets with Shatter. Ice Lance and Fingers of Frost make it a strong PvE spec now.
rotation: Keep Arcane Intellect and Ice Barrier up
Frost Armor solo, Mage Armor in groups
Ice Lance on Fingers of Frost procs
Frost Nova then Ice Lance when no proc
Cone of Cold to slow or reposition
talents: Frost/Arcane sustained build with Arctic Reach, or a close-range Winter's Chill build; core picks are Shatter, Ice Shards, Fingers of Frost, Ice Lance, Ice Barrier and Arcane Meditation.
forevChanges: Ice Lance and Fingers of Frost let Shatter work reliably on single targets without the old Frostbite/Frost Nova combo.
tips: Queue Ice Lance during Frostbolt when you expect a proc
Ice Barrier also boosts Frost damage
Take Frost Channeling and Arcane Meditation for mana
Use terrain to make slowed enemies path around you

name: Holy Paladin
summary: A direct healer with big cast-time heals and bursty crits but no HoTs or shields. Reactive healing backed by great group utility and personal survivability.
rotation: Keep Seal of Wisdom on the target
Holy Shock when someone may die before a cast lands, or while moving
Holy Light on heavy damage, started early
Holy Light on Infusion of Light procs
Flash of Light for lighter damage
talents: Reverence, Illumination, Divine Favor, Holy Shock and Light's Vigil (the only AoE heal).
bestRaces: Undead: the only Horde Paladin race
forevChanges: New Reverence talent lets Spirit regenerate mana in combat; Paladins have limited race choices (Horde: Undead only).
tips: Salvation on everyone but tanks
Blessing of Protection on anyone pulling threat
Blessing of Freedom on rooted players
Divine Intervention a distant healer to save a wipe
Lay on Hands drains all your mana

name: Protection Paladin
summary: A spell-powered tank mixing melee with Consecration, Judgement and Holy Shield, with Blessings and bubbles for the group. Excellent AoE threat, but low mobility and mana pressure in long single-target fights.
statPriority: Spell Power (most of the kit scales with it)
rotation: Seal of the Crusader before the pull, open with Judgement
Judgement and Swift Judgement on cooldown
talents: Mana sustain through Shield Specialization, block and defensive talents, threat talents and extra taunts.
forevChanges: Forever-only tools: Templar's Bulwark, Swift Judgement and Iron Creed, plus Legacy talent points.
tips: Seal of Wisdom on the boss helps everyone's mana
Salvation on non-tanks out of combat
Blessing of Sacrifice on targets taking many small hits

name: Retribution Paladin
summary: Heavy-armoured melee burst with slow, powerful swings and some spellcasting. Good survivability and group utility, but limited by mana.
statPriority: Intellect / Spell Power (Champion of the Light converts Intellect)
rotation: Seal of the Crusader before the pull
Open with Judgement of the Crusader
With Twist of Light, run Command and Righteousness together
talents: Benediction, Sanctified Judgement, Holy Conduit, Sacred Arbiter, Champion of the Light, Instrument of Law (Hammer of Wrath in PvE) and Twist of Light (two Seals at once).
forevChanges: New Twist of Light (two Seals), Sacred Arbiter and Instrument of Law.
tips: Use a slow, heavy two-hander
Divine Shield beats Divine Protection since you can keep attacking
Blacksmithing gives early Mail and Plate spell power gear

name: Discipline Priest
summary: Shields and heals, excelling at tank healing, and brings one of the best buffs in the game with Power Infusion. Weaker at spread-out group healing and has little mobility.
rotation: Power Word: Shield on tank, casters or yourself
Greater Heal + Inner Focus for big hits
talents: 31/20/0 with Meditation, Soul Warding, Penance and Power Infusion.
bestRaces: Human: Divine Grace removes Weakened Soul
forevChanges: Meditation buffed to 50% casting regen; mouseover casting is built in; new priest-friendly Tailoring, Enchanting and Engineering recipes.
tips: Pair Inner Focus with big heals
Fade before threat gets out of hand
Enable mouseover casting in Combat options

name: Holy Priest
summary: A versatile raid healer with a tool for every situation but almost no movement abilities.
rotation: Spread Renew across targets taking steady damage
Power Word: Shield to stop pushback and pre-shield
Greater Heal + Inner Focus for big hits
talents: 18/33/0: Improved Renew, Holy Binding, Spiritual Guidance, Litany of Light, Spiritual Healing, Prayer of Mending and Meditation.
forevChanges: Holy Binding makes Flash Heal heal you for half; new Litany of Light helps mana; Meditation buffed.
tips: Vary your spells to save mana
Use click-casting or mouseover
Library Books unlock the Philanthropist's Ring

name: Shadow Priest
summary: Shadow damage through DoTs, Mind Blast and Mind Flay, while Vampiric Embrace passively heals the group.
rotation: Fill with Mind Flay, letting it finish
talents: 14/3/34: Mind Flay, Improved Mind Flay, Vampiric Embrace, Shadow Weaving and Shadowform; Silence now doubles as an interrupt.
forevChanges: New Devouring Contagion spreads Devouring Plague; Improved Mind Flay and Silence reworked.
tips: Finish every Mind Flay: the last tick hits hardest
Leave Shadowform to heal
Get the Gravestone Scepter wand from Blackfathom Deeps

name: Assassination Rogue
summary: Dagger-and-poison specialist, now much stronger with Mutilate and Venom. High damage but juggles Slice and Dice, Venom and Expose Armor.
statPriority: Attack Power (poisons scale with it now)
rotation: Build with Mutilate (Sinister Strike at 4 points)
Expose Armor at 5 points on bosses
Eviscerate (or Kidney Shot) with spare points
talents: Malice, Ruthlessness, Relentless Strikes, Improved Slice and Dice, Improved Poisons, Vile Poisons, Seal Fate and Venom; Precision for raids.
forevChanges: New Mutilate and Venom; poisons can crit and scale with AP; Improved Expose Armor is cheaper and refunds combo points.
tips: Instant Poison on slow weapons, Deadly on fast
Don't switch targets mid-combo
Rogues have no AoE: kill packs one at a time

name: Combat Rogue
summary: Fights head-on with strong auto-attacks and burst, and is the only Rogue spec with real cleave (Blade Flurry). Very gear- and weapon-dependent.
rotation: Open with Ambush (daggers) or Garrote / Cheap Shot
Shank on cooldown for Energy and Venom
Expose Armor in long fights, Eviscerate with leftovers
talents: Malice, Improved Slice and Dice, Hack and Slash, Dual Wield Specialization, Blade Flurry, Flash of Steel and Adrenaline Rush; dagger and hybrid variants exist.
forevChanges: Hack and Slash lets you use any weapon type; new Shank ability; smooth Energy regen; poisons crit and scale with AP; Restless Blades removed.
tips: Never swap targets mid-combo
Vanish can drop combat to reset a bad fight
Kick casters, Evasion when tanking

name: Subtlety Rogue
summary: Two playstyles: a Bleed build empowering Rupture and Garrote, or an Ambush build with big crit burst. Revamped and now competitive in PvE.
rotation: Ghostly Strike on cooldown (enables Ambush in combat)
Death Mark once Slice and Dice and Expose are up
Eviscerate leftovers; Vanish + Ambush; Preparation to reset
talents: Ambush build: Opportunity, Master of Deception, Ghostly Strike, Death Mark. Bleed build adds Dirty Deeds and Blood Splatter. Both take Malice and Serrated Blades.
forevChanges: Ambush usable in combat via Ghostly Strike; new Death Mark finisher stores damage and explodes after 6 sec.
tips: Bleeds ignore armour: great on armoured bosses
Slice and Dice is your strongest finisher
No AoE: one target at a time

name: Elemental Shaman
summary: Slow to start but strong single-target and AoE caster damage, plus raid-wide totems and lots of utility. Mana is the constant limit.
statPriority: Spirit (main mana regen stat in Forever)
rotation: Drop Searing Totem once in combat
Pull with Lava Burst, then Flame Shock
AoE: Magma Totem, Fire Nova on cooldown, Chain Lightning with spare mana
talents: Elemental Focus (free casts), Trial By Fire (AoE), Lava Burst, Earthbound for kiting and Lightning Overload.
bestRaces: Orc: Blood Fury burst (top Horde pick)
forevChanges: Totems are now raid-wide; Magma Totem and Fire Nova are separate spells; Call of the Elements, Totemic Projection and Totemic Recall; Ghost Wolf works indoors.
tips: Always spend Clearcasting procs
Carry mana potions
Coordinate totems with other Shamans
Take Mindfulness when you have spare points

name: Enhancement Shaman
summary: Big Windfury burst on a two-hander plus lots of group buffs and utility. Weapon-dependent, mana-hungry and fairly squishy; can tank early dungeons.
rotation: Keep Lightning Shield and Windfury (or Rockbiter) Weapon up
Open with Lightning Bolt, then Stormstrike on cooldown
Instant Lightning Bolt on Maelstrom stacks during the Stormstrike debuff
AoE: Magma Totem and Fire Nova
talents: Improved Ghost Wolf, Mental Dexterity, Shamanistic Focus, Flurry, Stormstrike, Improved Stormstrike and Maelstrom Weapon.
forevChanges: Maelstrom Weapon and easier Stormstrike make the rotation more engaging; totems are raid-wide; Call of the Elements drops all four totems at once.
tips: Keep upgrading your weapon
Manage mana with Shamanistic Focus and Mana Spring Totem
Place totems where the boss won't be pulled away from them
Tanking works early but lacks a true taunt

name: Restoration Shaman
summary: A straightforward healer for single-target and group healing, with strong totem buffs and mana regen. Forever adds Riptide, raid-wide totems and more mobility.
rotation: Chain Heal from a target near other injured players (ideally one with Riptide)
Healing Stream Totem when your water slot is free
Lesser Healing Wave for urgent heals
talents: Mindfulness, Water Shield, Mana Tide Totem, Ancestral Healing, Tidal Mastery, Nature's Swiftness and Riptide.
forevChanges: New Riptide (instant heal + HoT that boosts Chain Heal); totems are raid-wide; Ghost Wolf works indoors.
tips: Cast a heal, then Riptide right after for burst
Keep Chain Heal targets close together
Macro Nature's Swiftness with a heal
Place Mana Tide where other healers benefit

name: Affliction Warlock
summary: Spreads DoTs that tick while you cast fillers or move, building damage over long fights. Weak burst, very self-sufficient with Life Tap and drains.
rotation: Bane of Doom if 1+ minute left, otherwise Amplify Curse + Bane of Agony
Your assigned Curse (Elements for casters, Recklessness for melee)
Shadow Bolt only on instant Shadow Trance
Life Tap in gaps or while moving
Wrack as filler, breaking it to refresh DoTs
talents: Level 60 raid build uses Wrack as filler; the SM/Ruin build keeps Shadow Bolt and suits dungeons where you move a lot.
forevChanges: DoTs can crit; Curses and Banes are separate; new Pandemic and Wrack talents; Life Tap scales with Spirit.
tips: Refresh DoTs right as they expire
Stack cooldowns in the 15 sec before Doom explodes
Skip DoTs on mobs about to die
Bind demon Attack/Follow to easy keys

name: Demonology Warlock
summary: Sacrifice one demon for its power while fighting with another, then build around Fire or Shadow. Both versions are within about 3% of each other, and the spec is sturdy thanks to Soul Link.
statPriority: Spell Power / your school (Fire or Shadow)
rotation: Fire build: Searing Pain when Demonic Brand is missing
Bane of Doom (1+ min) or Bane of Agony
Soul Fire during Decimation (Shadow Bolt for the Shadow build)
talents: 2/31/18 for both: Demonic Pact, Demonic Knowledge, Demonic Brand and Decimation; Fire favours Immolate talents, Shadow takes Improved Shadow Bolt.
bestRaces: Orc: demon damage + Blood Fury (best fit)
forevChanges: Demonic Pact keeps the sacrifice bonus with a demon out; demons scale with your gear; Demonic Brand feeds your pet; Decimation adds an execute phase.
tips: Play the Fire build in dungeons
Aim to finish fights with an empty mana bar
Boss AoE only half-hits demons
Skip Hellfire on two targets

name: Destruction Warlock
summary: Fire and Shadow burst and AoE: keep Immolate and DoTs up, fire Conflagrate and Shadowburn on cooldown, fill with Incinerate.
rotation: Bane of Doom (1+ min) or Amplify Curse + Bane of Agony
Conflagrate on cooldown while Immolate is up
Shadowburn on cooldown with a Soul Shard
talents: Best raid option is the Sayaad build (14/4/33); Imp and Demonic Sacrifice alternatives exist.
forevChanges: Incinerate is the new filler; Shadow and Flame lets Conflagrate and Shadowburn go on cooldown; new Bane of Havoc for cleave; Life Tap scales with Spirit.
tips: Use Conflagrate and Shadowburn as soon as ready
Two targets: Bane of Havoc on the second, skip Hellfire
Hellfire only on 3+ mobs in dungeons
